summary: Determine integration tick freshness from the published edge revision and retain local revision probes only as diagnostics.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes. Developer tick logs add localServedSha and localServedError diagnostics.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only scripts. Tick servedSha and current now describe the published user-facing edge; the local listener cannot establish freshness.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners can adopt the corrected freshness probe.

recovery.detail: No persistent application state changes. Failed edge observations report current false with a short error.
